scientific.integrity: Exact distribution proved by classifying the two unoriented projective sign directions in dimension two; independent exact-rational enumeration is a verification guard, not a substitute for the all-k proof.
limitations: Only the mathematically defined naive XTrace and XNysTrace algorithms with unnormalized Rademacher test vectors.
Fast full-rank implementations, Gaussian and spherically normalized options are not assessed.
One-stage false-stop probability is not a theorem about final multi-stage outcomes.
Posterior estimate is a heuristic proxy, not a source guarantee of per-run certification.

title: Exact posterior-error and false-stop law for sign-probed XTrace on a rank-two identity
